title: Computed Tomography of the Paranasal Sinuses

criteria.summary: Sinonasal symptoms for at least 12 weeks
At least 4 weeks of maximal medical therapy without adequate response

passages.text: This policy applies to outpatient professional claims for CT of the maxillofacial area and paranasal sinuses without contrast, CPT 70486, with dates of service on or after January 1, 2026.
Sinus CT is considered medically necessary when criteria 3.1 and 3.2 are both met, or when criterion 3.3 is met.
The member has sinonasal symptoms that have been present for at least 12 weeks.
The member has completed at least 4 weeks of maximal medical therapy, an intranasal steroid with saline irrigation, with or without antibiotics, without adequate response.
A complication is suspected: orbital or intracranial extension, or a neoplasm. When a complication is suspected, criteria 3.1 and 3.2 do not apply.

Documentation supporting each applicable criterion must be available in the medical record on request. Absence of documentation for a required criterion does not establish that the criterion was not met.
